live_note: Kept current by a poller: one public leaderboard read every 30 minutes by day, hourly overnight. The contest site republishes every few hours, so this page can trail the poll.

medals.note: Assumed from Kaggle's usual medal rule for 100 to 249 teams (gold top 10, silver top 20%, bronze top 40%, rounded up). The competition's own rules were not read for medals and may award none; treat these lines as a guide only.

turnaround.method: First time our snapshot showed a new entry minus the entry's submit time. An upper bound: it includes the gap between our reads. Only entries that change a team's shown score or date appear, as the public CSV lists one entry per team.
